title: Network Ops Desk Callback: 40% Call Overflow, Ref NOC-26-03118

transcript.speaker: NOC Analyst
transcript.text: Great Plains, this is Reggie Ostrander at the network operations desk, calling back on your overflow request.

transcript.speaker: Surge Commander
transcript.text: Go ahead.

transcript.speaker: NOC Analyst
transcript.text: I have your request for 40 percent of in-state calls to backup, logged a few minutes ago. I'm putting the overflow share change in now. Expect it live around 14:27 to 14:29.

transcript.speaker: NOC Analyst
transcript.text: Your confirmation e-mail is coming from noc-desk@988netadmin.example, with change ref NOC-26-03118. That's N-O-C, two-six, zero-three-one-one-eight.

transcript.speaker: Surge Commander
transcript.text: Understood. Calls only, 40 percent, live about 14:27.

transcript.speaker: NOC Analyst
transcript.text: Correct, calls only. Heads-up, though. I'll need your state 988 coordinator to confirm the request on our side. And I can't promise you a full 40 percent if the backup roster stays as busy as it is right now. Some of it may still ring back to you.

transcript.speaker: Surge Commander
transcript.text: Got it. Anything else you need from us?

transcript.speaker: NOC Analyst
transcript.text: Just the coordinator's confirmation. Watch for the e-mail, and call this line if it isn't showing live by 14:30. Good luck this afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Text message to Surge Commander desk phone, 14:21:47, from Dana Whitcomb, Supervisor, State Backup Center
transcript.text: We can take a share of your texts. I have two supervisors ready but they don't have logins to the shared queue yet. Send them and tell me what share and start time.

voiceStyles.NOC Analyst: Calm, efficient operations analyst in their 30s, quick and practiced, faint keyboard noise and a quiet ops room behind
voiceStyles.Surge Commander: Played live by the Surge Commander; short, focused replies
voiceStyles.Text message to Surge Commander desk pho: Not voiced. The facilitator reads it as a text message arriving about 90 seconds after the call ends

instructorNote: This tests whether the Surge Commander logs both requests in the surge log (party, contact type, time requested, time support begins), tells the state coordinator and sets a 30-minute review, and whether the Technology Manager creates the two backup-supervisor logins and confirms the shared-queue change in the operations channel. Watch for anyone treating the call share as active before it shows live (about 14:27–14:29) and pulling supervisors or admin staff off the overflow too early. Branch: if the players have not asked for call overflow by 14:20, the analyst instead calls to ask whether Great Plains intends to request it, and says the network can place 40 percent if asked; the 14:27 live time then follows the request.
